messages:
Lucy: Quick idea — add a 'canary-checklist' template to deploy-bot so PMs/SEs can run a consistent pre-canary checklist before flipping traffic. includes: preflight, smoke, traffic-shift, short monitor window. Anyone object?

Mateo: Love it. I started a branch deploy-bot/templates and sketched a YAML. Will open a PR today.

Alex: +1. One question: how does template selection interact with version pinning? e.g. if someone pins during canary, should the promote step respect that?

Lucy: Plan suggestion: support a command like `/deploy --template=canary-checklist --pin=v2.3.1 --change-window="02:00-04:00" --dry-run` — dry-run prints the steps and required approvals.

deploy-bot: Tip: to preview template run ` /deploy --template=canary-checklist --mode=dryrun `
Preview (simulated):
1) preflight -> run `ci/preflight.sh`
2) start canary -> `deploy-bot start --tier=canary --pin=v2.3.1`
3) wait/monitor (10m) -> run `scripts/monitor_canary.py --threshold 0.95`
4) promote -> `deploy-bot promote` (requires flag `--allow-promote`)

Sarah: I like generating a release-notes fragment automatically from the release PR changelog entries and attaching it to the deploy metadata. Could add a `generate-release-notes` step in the template that calls `scripts/release_notes.py --pr $PR`.

Mateo: Added a preflight hook to call `ci/preflight.sh` and a health-check step. Example template YAML I pushed to the branch: 
```yaml
name: canary-checklist
steps:
  - name: preflight
    run: ci/preflight.sh
  - name: deploy-canary
    run: deploy-bot start --tier=canary --pin=${pin}
  - name: monitor
    wait: 600
    run: scripts/monitor_canary.py --threshold 0.95
  - name: generate-release-notes
    run: scripts/release_notes.py --pr=${pr}
  - name: promote
    optional: true
    run: deploy-bot promote --confirm
```

Alex: Can we support template variables like `${service}`, `${pin}`, `${change_window}` so teams can reuse the same checklist? Also want a telemetry tag so we can see which templates are used.

Lucy: Yes to variables. Also let's add an explicit `rollback-plan` step that records the revert command (and maybe a one-line `--rollback-snippet`) so oncall can act fast. Example rollback snippet: `/deploy --pin ${previous_version} --force`.

opsbot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-bot/pull/312 — "Add canary-checklist template + preflight hooks" (author: Mateo). CI: passing.

Sarah: tiny ask — include in the template a `notes/summary.md` placeholder so the deploy UI can render a short human-friendly summary for SRE and release docs.

Mateo: Will add telemetry, rollback-snippet, and the release-notes hook in the PR. Also adding a `--dry-run` validation step in the bot that validates variables and required approvals.

Lucy: Awesome. If CI stays green, can we merge by EOD and stage it to the staging deployer. I'll coordinate the change window and ping @eng-oncall before canary. :thumbsup:

Alex: +1 from me. small nit: ensure the promote step respects `--pin` and doesn't accidentally promote an unpinned image.

Mateo: On it — adding a safety check and a log entry: `deploy_template_invocation: canary-checklist` to capture usage. Updating PR now.

Lucy: Thanks all — this should make our deploy workflows much less ad-hoc.
